# Vortexia Bot

> Vortexia Bot (also known as Vortexia Discord Bot or Vortexia) is a free all-in-one Discord bot. It provides Lavalink music bot features, moderation tools, ticket system, economy, levels, embed builder and utility commands.

Official website: https://vortexia.run.place/
